profile.label: United States · Army · women · P5
notes: Every dimension is percentile 5 of that dimension alone: a boundary case, not a typical body.
The combined values mix surveys from 1946 to 2010. Body size and landmark definitions changed over such a period: for current personnel use the .latest file (now 'ANSUR II 2012', 2010).
